look_here_first: Look for opposite long-petioled broad leaves with coarse teeth and three strong basal veins, topped by loose white flat-topped clusters of tiny all-disk heads—no ray florets.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: erect rhizomatous perennial of shaded/moist sites

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: opposite broadly ovate to triangular long-petioled leaves

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: leaves coarsely toothed with three strong veins from near base

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: terminal corymbiform clusters of many small white heads

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: heads discoid: white disk florets only, no rays

key_traits.label: Leaf morphology
key_traits.text: Broadly ovate/triangular, coarsely toothed, commonly 3-veined from near base.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: White discoid heads with no ray florets.

key_traits.label: Reproductive confirmation
key_traits.text: Mature cypselae glabrous, not hispid, contrasted with A. havanensis (Flora of North America).
